title: Apple (AAPL) Secures Largest Ever US Chip Deal With Broadcom For $30 Billion
title_zh: 苹果 (AAPL) 以 300 亿美元与博通达成美国有史以来最大的芯片交易
summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) has agreed a multi year US chip manufacturing and co development deal with Broadcom valued at more than US$30b. The agreement runs through 2031 and covers the production of over 15b custom chips for Apple products in the US.
summary_zh: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) 已与 Broadcom 达成一项为期多年的美国芯片制造和联合开发协议，价值超过 300 亿美元。该协议有效期至 2031 年，涵盖在美国为 Apple 产品生产超过 15b 颗定制芯片。

title: S&P 500 ends down after Trump says Iran deal is 'over'
title_zh: 特朗普表示伊朗协议“结束”后标普 500 指数收低
summary: STORY: U.S. stocks finished mostly lower on Wednesday, with the Dow dropping about 1% and the S&P 500 shedding more than a quarter of a percent.
summary_zh: 故事：美国股市周三收盘大多走低，道指下跌约 1%，标准普尔 500 指数跌幅超过 25%。

title: As Cognizant Links Up with Google on AI Deal, Here’s How to Play CTSH Stock Now
title_zh: 随着 Cognizant 与 Google 就 AI 交易达成合作，现在介绍如何玩 CTSH 股票
summary: Cognizant is strengthening its AI push with Google, lifting optimism as investors weigh whether CTSH can build on the momentum.
summary_zh: Cognizant 正在与谷歌加强人工智能的合作，这在投资者权衡 CTSH 是否能够延续这一势头之际提振了人们的乐观情绪。

title: Broadcom stock jumps on Apple AI chip deal, while Nvidia's relative stock price drops
title_zh: 博通股价因苹果人工智能芯片交易而上涨，而英伟达的相对股价下跌
summary: Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton takes a closer look at some of Wednesday's trending tickers and stories, including Nvidia's (NVDA) relative stock price; Broadcom's (AVGO) and Apple's (AAPL) AI chip deal; and travel-related stocks like Carnival (CCL), United (UAL), and Delta (DAL).
summary_zh: 雅虎财经的 Josh Lipton 仔细研究了周三的一些热门股票和故事，包括 Nvidia (NVDA) 的相对股价；博通（AVGO）和苹果（AAPL）的人工智能芯片交易；以及与旅游相关的股票，如嘉年华 (CCL)、联合航空 (UAL) 和达美航空 (DAL)。

title: Apple and Intel Corporation (INTC) Chip Deal makes Strategic Sense but Production is Years Away
title_zh: 苹果和英特尔公司 (INTC) 芯片交易具有战略意义，但量产还需要数年时间
summary: Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) is one of the Best Stocks To Buy. On June 24, Reuters reported that a potential Apple and Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) chip manufacturing agreement could strengthen the latter’s contract chip business.
summary_zh: 英特尔公司（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）是最值得购买的股票之一。 6 月 24 日，路透社报道称，苹果和英特尔公司（纳斯达克股票代码：INTC）可能达成的芯片制造协议可能会加强后者的代工芯片业务。
